data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'naba' which means 'to ask for, seek, or request'. The name Muneebah refers to a person who is constantly seeking forgiveness and supplication from Allah. The name Muneebah carries the meaning “Supplicant, seeker of forgiveness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muneebah usually hope their child will grow to embody supplicant, seeker of forgiveness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
